name: Introduction to Chaotic Dynamical Systems
description: We begin with an analysis of the dynamics of one-dimensional maps of both the interval and the circle. Topics to be covered include chaos, elementary bifurcations. Sarkovski’s theorem, symbolic dynamics and chaotic behaviour. Higher dimensional dynamics, including horseshoes, Henon map. Stability of systems.
